title: Cancel finite-tag nuisance and acquire contrast from the same bounded records
statement: A second difference of the actual finite-tag correlation preserves quadratic actuator signal; a same-record bounded pilot targets random average contrast, with a joint rather than postselected error bound.

requires: Constant actuator over the horizon; fresh Gaussian pointers with exact centered zero-QP symmetry; independent geometry/coupling signs; common current instrument across the three geometries; retained source/old-force caps; a feasible pulse/phase/storage/remainder budget and predeclared positive M_req.
provides: A second difference of the actual finite-tag correlation preserves quadratic actuator signal; a same-record bounded pilot targets random average contrast, with a joint rather than postselected error bound.
assumptions: Predictable drift between trials is allowed, but current geometry-dependent electronics or unresolved phase/QP/storage floors are not removed. The host-free reference is mathematical, not a physical off switch or local thermal reset. Contrast is a random same-record target; no independent denominator, iid bath, arbitrary unknown-gain completion or optional-stopping theorem is supplied. A finite resource vector is not an acquired apparatus.
costs: The bounded scores have ranges 6R and 3R, with Hoeffding radii using factors 72 and 18. Relative acquisition costs order Delta_min^-4 trials and two fresh pointers per trial. Required finite pulse peak and slew can be enormous; actual preparation, work, storage, readout and source costs remain. A fixed instrument that cannot meet the host/remainder/contrast budget returns UNKNOWN.
contract.units: Delta has inverse-time units; h and tau are times; X,Y,M,R have detector-product units. Delta^2*h^2 is dimensionless. N counts actual trials, with two pointers each.
contract.obstruction: No numerical replay, apparatus, NESS/heat-startup operation, novelty or practical advantage is established. Existing completed root/owner acceptance is scoped to the exact pinned root draft; the companion is not silently credited with a separate independently pinned whole-file audit.

body: The zero-transverse odd-weighted Gaussian tag is a Jordan map. In the host-free reference its second-order gap dependence is -M*T^2/2+A*T+B. The (-1,2,-1) contrast cancels A,B and baseline. State-induced Duhamel on the actual old-history host marginal bounds the unconditional coefficient error, while bounded Dyson words bound the remainder. Scores X=3*v_geometry*W and Y=3*1_geometry0*W give martingale intervals; require an end-of-protocol lower contrast bound and intersect a Markov event rather than dividing by unknown acceptance probability. Invert the positive ratio only after the upper-data gate. The exact source audit is accepted for the pinned root draft; hardware is not acquired.
